plain: That last item turned out to be the problem.
One snapshot shows what's in memory. Two snapshots show what's *growing*, and growth is what a leak is.
That leads you straight to the code.
If you only need a number, keep a number.
If your Node service has a sawtooth memory graph, take two snapshots a few hours apart and look at the delta.
The main lesson: **don't stare at one heap snapshot. Take two and compare them.**
